items.title: Diamond Cross DXF Grid for Airy Privacy Screens
items.description: Small diamonds nest inside a dense grid of overlapping X-crosses, creating an airy, evenly perforated surface. The fine repeating lattice suits privacy screens, fence infill, and gates needing good airflow with a crisp geometric look.
